name: MonarchTruncatedText
title: TruncatedText
summary: Text cut after a few lines, with a button that shows the rest when the text is longer than that.
whenToUse: For long free text in a list, a card or a detail screen, such as a description or a note, where the first lines are enough most of the time.
whenNotToUse: For a title that must stay on one line without a way to expand, use MonarchText with maxLines = 1 and TextOverflow.Ellipsis. For text that is the main content of a screen, show it whole.
api: @Composable fun MonarchTruncatedText(text: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, maxLines: Int = MonarchTruncatedTextTokens.DEFAULT_MAX_LINES, expandable: Boolean = true, style: MonarchTextStyle = MonarchTextStyle.Body, showMoreLabel: String? = null, showLessLabel: String? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchTruncatedText(text: String, expanded: Boolean, onExpandedChange: (Boolean) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, maxLines: Int = MonarchTruncatedTextTokens.DEFAULT_MAX_LINES, expandable: Boolean = true, style: MonarchTextStyle = MonarchTextStyle.Body, showMoreLabel: String? = null, showLessLabel: String? = null)

options.name: expanded
options.description: Whether the whole text is shown. The first form keeps this state itself, in rememberSaveable, starting cut.

options.name: onExpandedChange
options.description: Called with the new state when the user activates the button.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the text and its button.

options.name: maxLines
options.description: How many lines are shown before the text is cut. Values below 1 count as 1.

options.name: expandable
options.description: Whether a button shows the rest when the text is cut.

options.name: style
options.description: The type role of the text.

options.name: showMoreLabel
options.description: The button label while cut. null uses monarch_truncatedtext_show_more, "Show more".

options.name: showLessLabel
options.description: The button label while expanded. null uses monarch_truncatedtext_show_less, "Show less".

states.name: cut
states.description: The text is longer than maxLines: the last line ends with an ellipsis and a "Show more" button follows.

states.name: expanded
states.description: All lines are shown and the button reads "Show less".

states.name: fits
states.description: The text is within maxLines: no button.

appearance: The text uses the chosen type role in the content color of the surface; the button is a small ghost MonarchButton in the default text color, in every theme.
platformNotes: The web tooltip option is not offered: there is no hover on touch, and TalkBack reads the whole text without it. The web accepts inline elements (links, emphasis); this takes a plain String. The line limit is called maxLines, as on the Compose Text, where iOS calls it lineLimit. Whether the text is cut is read from the text layout (TextLayoutResult.hasVisualOverflow), so no hidden copy of the text is measured. The button is a ghost MonarchButton in the default text color where the web uses the link color, because Monarch for Android has no link-styled button yet.
accessibility: TalkBack reads the whole text whether or not it is cut, because the cut is only a line limit on one Text.
The button is a separate button whose label changes between "Show more" and "Show less"; both labels can be replaced.
The button reserves a 48dp touch target.
The change of height is animated with the Monarch motion spec, which is immediate when animations are turned off.
At the largest font size the expanded text and the button are not cut off.
edgeCases: The button appears after the first layout pass, when the text layout is known.
With expandable = false the cut text has no visible way to expand; use it only where the whole text is one tap away.
An empty string shows nothing and no button.
With expanded = true and text that fits, the button still shows so the state can be turned off.
The button has horizontal padding, so its label is indented from the text by that padding.

examples.title: Three lines with Show more
examples.code:
MonarchTruncatedText(
    text = "Quarterly planning notes covering hiring for the support team, the roadmap for the next two releases, the migration of the reporting service to the new storage layer and the open questions we still need answers to before the review.",
    maxLines = 3,
)

examples.title: The expanded state held by the app
examples.code:
MonarchTruncatedText(
    text = "Renewal is due on the first of the month. The account owner gets a reminder a week before.",
    expanded = expanded,
    onExpandedChange = { expanded = it },
    maxLines = 1,
)
